XunoNext Orchestration API (3.1.1)

Download OpenAPI specification:

License: Proprietary — Xuno

XunoNext is an orchestration layer over Cross River Bank (banking rails), Sila Money (US KYC) and a Nepal settlement / validation partner. A consuming platform (the Xuno client app, or any Xuno-like product) calls this one API and never talks to a provider directly.

v3.1 — what changed from v3.0

  • Provider-referenced onboarding. A customer or recipient may be created with identitySource: PROVIDER_REFERENCE and a vendor handle (e.g. a Sila USER_HANDLE, or a Nepal KYC partner CUSTOMER_ID) instead of the full identity payload. XunoNext resolves the identity from the provider. KYC may likewise adopt an existing provider verification via kycSource: PROVIDER_REFERENCE.
  • Recipients are a first-class resource, scoped to their sender. role still discriminates (SENDER on a customer, RECIPIENT on a recipient) but recipients live at /customers/{customerId}/recipients/... with their own KYC, documents and bank accounts. Ids are RCPT- prefixed and entityType is recipient.
  • Transactions reference a sender and a recipient explicitly (sender.customerId, recipient.recipientId) and belongsTo carries both parties.
  • Bank-referenced Nepal onboarding (3.1.1). A Nepal customer may be created from a Laxmi Bank user identifier / token (providerReference.provider: LAXMI_BANK). Resolution is synchronous: the 201 response already carries the identity and the bank-held KYC record (providerKyc).
  • Sila-referenced US bank accounts (3.1.1). A US funding account may be registered by naming the account already linked at Sila (source: PROVIDER_REFERENCE) instead of sending routing / account numbers; XunoNext fetches the details from Sila once the record exists.
  • Transaction quotes with invoice (3.1.1). Non-US customers can obtain a priced, time-boxed quote by uploading an invoice (Base64) and naming the invoiced party. The quote is later consumed by POST /transactions via quoteId.
  • externalReferenceId everywhere (3.1.1). Every resource accepts, stores, returns, filters on and emits in webhooks the platform's own identifier. Transactions' v3.0 referenceId is kept as a deprecated alias.
  • Sila identifiers on US bank accounts (3.1.1). us.silaUserHandle and us.silaEntityId on create and on the record, for both inline and Sila-referenced accounts.
  • Jurisdiction-shaped KYC state (3.1.1). GET .../kyc returns the same envelope for US and NP, discriminated by jurisdiction, with localized identification, address and partner-KYC blocks.
  • Uniform List / Update / Delete. Every collection exposes GET with the shared page / pageSize / sortBy / sortOrder parameters and the shared pagination envelope, PATCH for merge-patch updates and DELETE for soft delete (where the domain permits).

Conventions

  • All paths are relative to /api/v1.
  • Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> on every endpoint except /login and /health.
  • X-Idempotency-Key (UUID v4) is required on every POST that creates or moves money.
  • Every response is wrapped in the standard envelope: success, status, entityId, entityType, belongsTo[], entity. Lists return entities[] and pagination.
  • Errors carry a stable code — branch on code, never on message.
  • Amounts are decimal strings with two places. Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC.

Customers (Senders)

A customer is the sending party (role: SENDER). Created inline or by provider reference.

Register a customer (sender)

Creates a role: SENDER customer. Two ways to supply identity:

  • identitySource: INLINE (default) — send individual, contact, address and identification shaped by jurisdiction. Returns 201 with kycStatus: REGISTERED.
  • identitySource: PROVIDER_REFERENCE — send providerReference and omit the identity block. XunoNext fetches the identity from the provider.
    • Sila USER_HANDLE (US): resolution is asynchronous. Returns 202 with kycStatus: IDENTITY_PENDING; customer.registered fires once resolved, or customer.identity.action_required names any fields the provider could not supply.
    • Laxmi Bank BANK_USER_ID / BANK_TOKEN (NP): resolution is synchronous. XunoNext calls the bank with the identifier or token, maps the bank's customer record onto individual, address, identification and returns 201 with identityResolution.status: RESOLVED and the bank-held KYC summary in providerKyc. If the bank record is incomplete the response is still 201 with identityResolution.status: PARTIAL and missingFields. If the token is expired or not issued to this platform: 422 ERR_PROVIDER_REFERENCE_INACCESSIBLE.

To create a recipient use POST /customers/{customerId}/recipients; role: RECIPIENT here is rejected.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

role
required
string
Value: "SENDER"

Recipients are created under /customers/{id}/recipients.

jurisdiction
required
string (Jurisdiction)
Enum: "US" "NP"
type
required
string (CustomerType)
Value: "INDIVIDUAL"

BUSINESS reserved.

identitySource
string (IdentitySource)
Enum: "INLINE" "PROVIDER_REFERENCE"

INLINE — identity supplied in the body. PROVIDER_REFERENCE — identity resolved from a third-party vendor via providerReference.

object (ProviderReference)

A handle at a third-party vendor that XunoNext uses to fetch identity and/or verification data instead of receiving it inline. The handle must be reachable with the credentials XunoNext holds for that provider (e.g. the same Sila app_handle); otherwise 422 ERR_PROVIDER_REFERENCE_INACCESSIBLE.

object (IndividualInput)
object (Contact)
AddressUS (object) or AddressNP (object) (Address)
IdentificationUSInput (object) or IdentificationNPInput (object) (IdentificationInput)
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
query Parameters
page
integer >= 1
Default: 1

1-based page number.

externalReferenceId
string

Exact match on the platform's own identifier for the record.

pageSize
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 10

Items per page.

sortBy
string
Default: "createdAt"

Top-level entity field to sort by. Defaults to createdAt. Unknown fields return 400.

sortOrder
string
Default: "DESC"
Enum: "ASC" "DESC"
jurisdiction
string (Jurisdiction)
Enum: "US" "NP"
kycStatus
string (KycStatus)
Enum: "IDENTITY_PENDING" "REGISTERED" "KYC_PENDING" "KYC_PASSED" "KYC_ACTION_REQUIRED" "DOCS_SUBMITTED" "DOCS_REJECTED" "KYC_DECLINED" "ARCHIVED"
  • IDENTITY_PENDING — created by provider reference; identity not yet resolved from the vendor.
  • REGISTERED — record exists (US: entity registered at Sila); KYC not requested.
  • KYC_PENDING — verification / screening in flight.
  • KYC_PASSED — verified. transactable: true.
  • KYC_ACTION_REQUIRED — kycAction says what to correct or upload.
  • DOCS_SUBMITTED / DOCS_REJECTED — manual document review states.
  • KYC_DECLINED — terminal.
  • ARCHIVED — soft-deleted.
transactable
boolean
identitySource
string (IdentitySource)
Enum: "INLINE" "PROVIDER_REFERENCE"

INLINE — identity supplied in the body. PROVIDER_REFERENCE — identity resolved from a third-party vendor via providerReference.

kycProfile
string (KycProfile)
Enum: "US_SENDER_STANDARD" "NP_SENDER_STANDARD" "NP_RECIPIENT_BASIC"
search
string <= 100 characters

Case-insensitive match on full name, email or phone.

createdFrom
string <date-time>

Inclusive lower bound on createdAt.

createdTo
string <date-time>

Exclusive upper bound on createdAt.

object

Exact-match filter on metadata keys, e.g. ?metadata[platformUserId]=xuno-user-88213.

Update a customer (merge patch)

Only fields present are modified. Identity and identification fields are editable while kycStatus is REGISTERED, IDENTITY_PENDING (to supply fields the provider lacked) or KYC_ACTION_REQUIRED with action: CORRECT_DATA. After KYC_PASSED only contact, label and metadata may change. role, jurisdiction, type, identitySource and providerReference are immutable (400).

Archive a customer (soft delete)

Moves the customer to ARCHIVED. Refused with 409 while a transaction is in flight or an ACTIVE sub-account holds a non-zero balance. Archiving a sender archives their recipients (cascade) unless cascade=false, in which case the recipients remain and become unreachable until re-parented by operations.

BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

query Parameters
cascade
boolean

Customer KYC & Documents

KYC submission, remediation and document upload for a sender.

Submit a customer for KYC

Body is discriminated by kycProfile (US_SENDER_STANDARD for a US sender).

  • kycSource: XUNONEXT (default) — XunoNext requests verification at the engine for the profile. For a US sender this consumes one of two Sila attempts.
  • kycSource: PROVIDER_REFERENCE — only for a customer created with a providerReference. XunoNext reads the verification already held at the provider and adopts its outcome. No attempt is consumed. profile is optional; any field the corridor policy still requires and the provider does not hold is returned as KYC_ACTION_REQUIRED / CORRECT_DATA with correctableFields, again without consuming an attempt.

Upload a KYC document

multipart/form-data. For a US sender the bytes are forwarded to Sila against the open verification; uploads consume no KYC attempt. SSN and IDENTITY categories require two files in the same request. PNG, JPEG or PDF; 20 MB per request.

BearerAuth

required

externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

Recipients

A recipient (role: RECIPIENT) is created by and scoped to a sender. Created inline or by provider reference. Ids are RCPT- prefixed.

Create a recipient for a sender

Creates a role: RECIPIENT record owned by the sender in the path. The sender must exist, be role: SENDER and belong to the caller; it need not be KYC_PASSED to create a recipient, but it must be before the recipient can be submitted for KYC.

  • identitySource: INLINE (default) — send individual, contact, address and (when required by threshold) identification, shaped by jurisdiction (NP in MVP). Returns 201.
  • identitySource: PROVIDER_REFERENCE — send providerReference (e.g. NP_KYC_PARTNER / CUSTOMER_ID) and omit the identity block. Returns 202 with kycStatus: IDENTITY_PENDING.

belongsTo on every recipient response lists the owning sender.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

jurisdiction
required
string (Jurisdiction)
Enum: "US" "NP"
type
required
string (CustomerType)
Value: "INDIVIDUAL"

BUSINESS reserved.

relationshipToOwner
required
string (Relationship)
Enum: "SELF" "SPOUSE" "PARENT" "CHILD" "SIBLING" "GRANDPARENT" "IN_LAW" "OTHER_RELATIVE" "FRIEND" "EMPLOYEE" "BUSINESS_PARTNER" "OTHER"
identitySource
string (IdentitySource)
Enum: "INLINE" "PROVIDER_REFERENCE"

INLINE — identity supplied in the body. PROVIDER_REFERENCE — identity resolved from a third-party vendor via providerReference.

object (ProviderReference)

A handle at a third-party vendor that XunoNext uses to fetch identity and/or verification data instead of receiving it inline. The handle must be reachable with the credentials XunoNext holds for that provider (e.g. the same Sila app_handle); otherwise 422 ERR_PROVIDER_REFERENCE_INACCESSIBLE.

object (IndividualInput)
object (Contact)
AddressUS (object) or AddressNP (object) (Address)
IdentificationUSInput (object) or IdentificationNPInput (object) (IdentificationInput)
label
string <= 100 characters

Display name in the sender's app, e.g. "Mom".

object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

required

query Parameters

Top-level entity field to sort by. Defaults to createdAt. Unknown fields return 400.

sortOrder
string
Default: "DESC"
Enum: "ASC" "DESC"
kycStatus
string (KycStatus)
Enum: "IDENTITY_PENDING" "REGISTERED" "KYC_PENDING" "KYC_PASSED" "KYC_ACTION_REQUIRED" "DOCS_SUBMITTED" "DOCS_REJECTED" "KYC_DECLINED" "ARCHIVED"
  • IDENTITY_PENDING — created by provider reference; identity not yet resolved from the vendor.
  • REGISTERED — record exists (US: entity registered at Sila); KYC not requested.
  • KYC_PENDING — verification / screening in flight.
  • KYC_PASSED — verified. transactable: true.
  • KYC_ACTION_REQUIRED — kycAction says what to correct or upload.
  • DOCS_SUBMITTED / DOCS_REJECTED — manual document review states.
  • KYC_DECLINED — terminal.
  • ARCHIVED — soft-deleted.
transactable
boolean
payable
boolean

transactable AND at least one bank account with canReceive: true.

Update a recipient (merge patch)

Same rules as a customer. Editing name, date of birth, nationality or identification on a KYC_PASSED recipient re-triggers screening and moves it to KYC_PENDING. relationshipToOwner is editable and re-evaluates the relationship rules.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$

required

Request Body schema:
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

relationshipToOwner
string (Relationship)
Enum: "SELF" "SPOUSE" "PARENT" "CHILD" "SIBLING" "GRANDPARENT" "IN_LAW" "OTHER_RELATIVE" "FRIEND" "EMPLOYEE" "BUSINESS_PARTNER" "OTHER"
object (IndividualInput)
object (Contact)
AddressUS (object) or AddressNP (object) (Address)
IdentificationUSInput (object) or IdentificationNPInput (object) (IdentificationInput)
label
string <= 100 characters
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

Recipient KYC & Documents

Screening submission, remediation and document upload for a recipient.

Submit a recipient for KYC / screening

kycProfile: NP_RECIPIENT_BASIC. The owning sender must be KYC_PASSED.

  • kycSource: XUNONEXT — XunoNext runs sanctions/PEP screening and identification completeness checks. No attempt budget.
  • kycSource: PROVIDER_REFERENCE — adopt the verification held at the Nepal KYC partner referenced at creation. XunoNext still runs its own sanctions/PEP screen.
Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

recipientId
required
string^RCPT-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: RCPT-01JV7NC5M2Y8Q1W4E7R0T3U6I9

Recipient id (RCPT- ULID). Must be owned by customerId.

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
kycProfile
required
string
Value: "NP_RECIPIENT_BASIC"
kycSource
string (KycSource)
Enum: "XUNONEXT" "PROVIDER_REFERENCE"

XUNONEXT — XunoNext requests a fresh verification. PROVIDER_REFERENCE — adopt the verification already held at the vendor named in providerReference.

required
object (NPRecipientBasicProfile)

At least one of fatherName / motherName / spouseName is required.

Upload an identification document for a recipient

Retained in XunoNext's evidence store and queued for review. Adds CITIZENSHIP_CERTIFICATE, NATIONAL_ID_CARD, VOTER_ID document types.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

recipientId
required
string^RCPT-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: RCPT-01JV7NC5M2Y8Q1W4E7R0T3U6I9

Recipient id (RCPT- ULID). Must be owned by customerId.

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: multipart/form-data
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

documentCategory
required
string (DocumentCategory)
Enum: "ADDRESS" "NAME" "DOB" "SSN" "IDENTITY" "SOURCE_OF_FUNDS" "OTHER" "UNKNOWN" "INVOICE"
documentType
required
string

From kycAction.acceptedDocumentTypes for the category. NP adds CITIZENSHIP_CERTIFICATE, NATIONAL_ID_CARD, VOTER_ID.

files
required
Array of strings <binary> [ items <binary > ]

PNG, JPEG or PDF. Both sides of a two-sided document in the same request.

side
Array of strings
Items Enum: "FRONT" "BACK"

One per file part, for two-sided documents.

Customer Bank Accounts

Funding accounts owned by a sender (capabilities.canFund).

Register a funding bank account for a sender

Body has a common part and exactly one jurisdiction block (us or np) matching country. A verified account owned by a sender is granted capabilities.canFund.

  • source: INLINE (default) — US: PLAID_EVIDENCE returns 201 (status derived from the evidence); MICRODEPOSIT returns 202.
  • source: PROVIDER_REFERENCE (US only) — name the account already linked at Sila (providerReference.provider: SILA, referenceType: ACCOUNT_NAME). Omit us.routingNumber / us.accountNumber. XunoNext creates the record, returns 202 with accountResolution.status: PENDING, then fetches the account from Sila (/get_accounts): account type, routing number, last four, institution and Sila's link / verification state are filled in and bank_account.verified (or bank_account.relink_required) fires. The customer must itself be Sila-referenced (providerReference.provider: SILA) so the account is under the same user handle. us.achAuthorization is still required — XunoNext originates ACH through Cross River under its own authorization text.
Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

country
required
string (CountryCode) ^[A-Z]{2}$

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

currency
required
string (CurrencyCode) ^[A-Z]{3}$
source
string (BankAccountSource)
Enum: "INLINE" "PROVIDER_REFERENCE"

INLINE — account details in the body. PROVIDER_REFERENCE — details fetched from the provider named in providerReference after creation.

object (BankAccountProviderReference)

US only in 3.1.1. The account must be linked under the customer's own Sila user handle.

accountHolderName
string <= 140 characters
accountHolderIsCustomer
required
boolean

false requires accountHolderRelationship and flags for review. Must be false when the owner isMinor.

accountHolderRelationship
string (Relationship)
Enum: "SELF" "SPOUSE" "PARENT" "CHILD" "SIBLING" "GRANDPARENT" "IN_LAW" "OTHER_RELATIVE" "FRIEND" "EMPLOYEE" "BUSINESS_PARTNER" "OTHER"
label
string <= 100 characters
isPrimary
boolean
Default: false
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

object (BankAccountUSInput)

With source: INLINE (default), accountType, routingNumber, accountNumber and verificationMethod are required. With source: PROVIDER_REFERENCE they are forbidden — they are fetched from Sila — and only achAuthorization is required.

object (BankAccountNPInput)

Responses

Recipient Bank Accounts

Payout accounts owned by a recipient (capabilities.canReceive).

Register a payout bank account for a recipient

Same body shape as a sender account; in MVP the block is np. Partner account validation starts automatically and returns 202 with PENDING_VERIFICATION. A verified account owned by a recipient is granted capabilities.canReceive. belongsTo lists the recipient, then the sender.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$

recipientId
required
string^RCPT-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: RCPT-01JV7NC5M2Y8Q1W4E7R0T3U6I9

Recipient id (RCPT- ULID). Must be owned by customerId.

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

country
required
string (CountryCode) ^[A-Z]{2}$

ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

currency
required
string (CurrencyCode) ^[A-Z]{3}$
source
string (BankAccountSource)
Enum: "INLINE" "PROVIDER_REFERENCE"

INLINE — account details in the body. PROVIDER_REFERENCE — details fetched from the provider named in providerReference after creation.

object (BankAccountProviderReference)

US only in 3.1.1. The account must be linked under the customer's own Sila user handle.

accountHolderName
string <= 140 characters
accountHolderIsCustomer
required
boolean

false requires accountHolderRelationship and flags for review. Must be false when the owner isMinor.

accountHolderRelationship
string (Relationship)
Enum: "SELF" "SPOUSE" "PARENT" "CHILD" "SIBLING" "GRANDPARENT" "IN_LAW" "OTHER_RELATIVE" "FRIEND" "EMPLOYEE" "BUSINESS_PARTNER" "OTHER"
label
string <= 100 characters
isPrimary
boolean
Default: false
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

object (BankAccountUSInput)

With source: INLINE (default), accountType, routingNumber, accountNumber and verificationMethod are required. With source: PROVIDER_REFERENCE they are forbidden — they are fetched from Sila — and only achAuthorization is required.

object (BankAccountNPInput)

Update a recipient bank account (merge patch)

Editable — label, isPrimary, metadata, accountHolderRelationship. Bank, branch and account number are immutable.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

recipientId
required
string^RCPT-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: RCPT-01JV7NC5M2Y8Q1W4E7R0T3U6I9

Recipient id (RCPT- ULID). Must be owned by customerId.

bankAccountId
required
string^BANK-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: BANK-01JV7NB2K9X4M7P0Q3R8T5V2Y1
Request Body schema:
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

label
string <= 100 characters
isPrimary
boolean
accountHolderRelationship
string (Relationship)
Enum: "SELF" "SPOUSE" "PARENT" "CHILD" "SIBLING" "GRANDPARENT" "IN_LAW" "OTHER_RELATIVE" "FRIEND" "EMPLOYEE" "BUSINESS_PARTNER" "OTHER"
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

object

Sub-Accounts

Cross River DDA subledgers issued to a sender.

Issue a Cross River sub-account for a sender

Only role: SENDER and KYC_PASSED. One sub-account per purpose; a second request for an existing purpose returns 200 with the existing record.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

purpose
required
string (SubAccountPurpose)
Enum: "REMITTANCE_FUNDING" "WALLET" "SAVINGS"

REMITTANCE_FUNDING callable in v3.1; WALLET and SAVINGS reserved.

label
string <= 100 characters
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

Responses

Sandbox

https://sandbox.xunonext.xuno.co/api/v1/customers/{customerId}/sub-accounts

Production

https://production.xunonext.xuno.co/api/v1/customers/{customerId}/sub-accounts

Transactions

Cross-border transfers from a sender to one of their recipients.

Create a cross-border transaction

The caller names the sender (customerId, funding bankAccountId, optional subAccountId) and the recipient (recipientId — must be owned by the sender — and optional payout bankAccountId, defaulting to the recipient's primary canReceive account). XunoNext derives the rails and sequences the legs. belongsTo carries the sender (customer) and the recipient (recipient).

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

type
required
string
Value: "CROSS_BORDER"
referenceId
string^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,45}$
Deprecated

Legacy alias of externalReferenceId (v3.0). If both are sent they must be equal. Propagated to Cross River as clientIdentifier.

required
object (TransactionSenderInput)
required
object (TransactionRecipientInput)
object (TransactionAmount)

Exactly one of sendAmount / receiveAmount, matching basis.

quoteId
string^QUOT-[0-9A-Z]{26}$

Consume a transaction quote (invoice-backed). The quote must belong to sender.customerId, be QUOTED and unexpired (422 ERR_QUOTE_EXPIRED). amount and fees may then be omitted and are taken from the quote; if supplied they must match. The recipient is name-matched to the invoiced party (422 INVOICE_PARTY_MISMATCH).

Array of objects (FeeInstruction)
purposeCode
string (PurposeCode)
Enum: "FAMILY_SUPPORT" "EDUCATION" "MEDICAL" "SAVINGS" "LOAN_REPAYMENT" "PROPERTY" "BUSINESS" "GIFT_DONATION" "TRAVEL_EVENT" "OWN_ACCOUNT" "OTHER"
purposeText
string <= 50 characters

Required when purposeCode is OTHER.

priority
boolean
Default: false

true sends over SWIFT.

achProcessingMode
string
Default: "STANDARD"
Enum: "STANDARD" "SAME_DAY"
required
object (SessionEvidence)
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

Update a transaction (metadata only)

Only metadata is mutable after creation. All money fields are immutable; to change them cancel and re-create.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
transactionId
required
string^TXN-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: TXN-01JV7NG7T8D3F6H9J2K5L8M1N4
Request Body schema:
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

Sandbox

https://sandbox.xunonext.xuno.co/api/v1/transactions/{transactionId}

Production

https://production.xunonext.xuno.co/api/v1/transactions/{transactionId}

Cancel a transaction

Permitted while CREATED, SCREENING, COMPLIANCE_HOLD or FUNDING_PENDING and before cancellationDeadlineAt. 409 once the payout is submitted. Transactions are never deleted; cancel is the only caller-initiated terminal transition.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
transactionId
required
string^TXN-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: TXN-01JV7NG7T8D3F6H9J2K5L8M1N4
Request Body schema: application/json
optional
reason
string <= 200 characters

Transaction Quotes

Priced, time-boxed quotes backed by an uploaded invoice. Available to non-US (jurisdiction: NP) customers. Ids are QUOT- prefixed. A quote is consumed by POST /transactions via quoteId.

Request a transaction quote against an invoice

Available to customers whose jurisdiction is not US (in 3.1.1: NP) and who are KYC_PASSED. A US customer receives 422 ERR_BUSINESS_RULE / JURISDICTION_NOT_PERMITTED.

The caller uploads the invoice as Base64 and names the invoiced party — a person or a business — with a contact phone and email. XunoNext stores the invoice as a document (category INVOICE, reviewStatus: PENDING_REVIEW), prices the transfer and returns a time-boxed quote whose rate is held until expiresAt (15 minutes in MVP).

The quote is consumed by POST /transactions with quoteId. At that point amount and fees may be omitted (taken from the quote), the recipient must resolve to the invoiced party (invoicedTo.name is name-matched against the recipient; mismatch → 422 INVOICE_PARTY_MISMATCH) and the transaction carries invoice.documentId. If the invoice is still PENDING_REVIEW the transaction enters COMPLIANCE_HOLD until it is accepted.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$
Example: CUST-01JV7MZK6A5N3J5X2P9R4T1V6W

Sender customer id (CUST- ULID).

header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

type
required
string
Value: "CROSS_BORDER"
required
object (TransactionAmount)

Exactly one of sendAmount / receiveAmount, matching basis.

purposeCode
string (PurposeCode)
Enum: "FAMILY_SUPPORT" "EDUCATION" "MEDICAL" "SAVINGS" "LOAN_REPAYMENT" "PROPERTY" "BUSINESS" "GIFT_DONATION" "TRAVEL_EVENT" "OWN_ACCOUNT" "OTHER"
purposeText
string <= 50 characters
required
object (InvoiceUpload)
required
object (InvoicedParty)

The person or business the invoice is issued to — i.e. the party that will be paid.

Array of objects (FeeInstruction)
priority
boolean
Default: false
object (Metadata) <= 50 properties

Free-form string map. Not interpreted. Nested objects rejected.

Responses

BearerAuth
path Parameters
customerId
required
string^CUST-[0-9A-Z]{26}$

quoteId
required
string^QUOT-[0-9A-Z]{26}$

Webhook Subscriptions

Register endpoints to receive XunoNext events.

Create a subscription

The signing secret is returned once, in this response only.

Authorizations:
BearerAuth
header Parameters
X-Idempotency-Key
required
string <uuid>

UUID v4, generated once per logical operation and persisted before calling. Same key + same payload replays the original response; same key + different payload is 409.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
externalReferenceId
string or null (ExternalReferenceId) ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,64}$

The consuming platform's own identifier for this record (its user id, account id, order id, invoice id, ...). Present on every resource. Unique per platform per resource type — a repeat on create returns 409 ERR_CONFLICT with reason: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_IN_USE. Editable by PATCH. Every list endpoint accepts externalReferenceId as an exact-match filter, and every webhook payload carries it, so the platform can correlate without a lookup.

url
required
string <uri> ^https://
events
required
Array of strings (WebhookEventType) non-empty
Items Enum: "customer.registered" "customer.identity.action_required" "customer.kyc.pending" "customer.kyc.passed" "customer.kyc.action_required" "customer.kyc.documents_submitted" "customer.kyc.declined" "customer.screening.hit" "customer.archived" "recipient.registered" "recipient.identity.action_required" "recipient.kyc.pending" "recipient.kyc.passed" "recipient.kyc.action_required" "recipient.kyc.documents_submitted" "recipient.kyc.declined" "recipient.screening.hit" "recipient.archived" "bank_account.microdeposits_sent" "bank_account.verified" "bank_account.name_mismatch" "bank_account.verification_failed" "bank_account.relink_required" "bank_account.blocked" "bank_account.removed" "bank_account.resolution.action_required" "transaction_quote.created" "transaction_quote.under_review" "transaction_quote.invoice_accepted" "transaction_quote.invoice_rejected" "transaction_quote.expired" "transaction_quote.consumed" "sub_account.activated" "sub_account.frozen" "sub_account.closed" "transaction.created" "transaction.compliance_hold" "transaction.funded" "transaction.rate_changed" "transaction.payout_sent" "transaction.completed" "transaction.failed" "transaction.returned" "transaction.refunded" "transaction.cancelled" "subscription.ping"
description
string <= 200 characters

Responses

Sandbox

https://sandbox.xunonext.xuno.co/api/v1/webhook-subscriptions

Production

https://production.xunonext.xuno.co/api/v1/webhook-subscriptions
